floor1.mode: Built-in image_gen, style-transfer with two reference images
floor1.prompt: Redraw the exact first-floor room, furniture, and doorway layout in the second-floor reference’s crisp square pixel blocks, honey timber, charcoal wall outlines and warm amber lights. Remove every annotation, title, letter and sign and reconstruct the underlying surface. Keep kitchen, laundry, dining, workshop, garage, living room, cat passage with three nests, stairwell, empty green mahjong table, corridor, parents bedroom and ensuite in their original proportional locations. No tile faces, humans, bodies or photographs. No invented doorway frames. No blur, noise or sharpening. Whole 4:3 game floor background.
floor1.integration: User follow-up requested coarser Stardew Valley-like pixels. Sample the first floor to 724×543, expand by nearest neighbor to 1448×1086. Extract all foregrounds from this same raster. Composite the generated secondary clean-clothes cupboard into its existing wall recess.
